evidence_limits: No firsthand cooking trial, maker interview, local or language review.

The origin anecdote has no inspected contemporary archival witness.
Kamadhenu enterprise lead remains in existing KB; full case study unavailable and not used in public article.
reading_gain: Explains the relation of browned surface and centre, distinguishes cooking leaves from serving, separates place association and later origin anecdote, and compares changes to mixture versus restaurant presentation with named contributors.
